title: Scheduled messages
subtitle: The bot sends the message to the chosen channel at the time you set (Vietnam time).

create.title: Schedule a message
create.sourceHelp: Paste a Discord message link. The bot copies the message when it sends.
create.dateHelp: Leave empty for today. Enter today, tomorrow, or a date as day/month (25/10) or day/month/year (25/10/2026). The day comes first.

errors.invalidTime: This time is not valid. Use a form like 21:30, 30m or 1h30m.
errors.invalidDate: This date is not valid. Enter today, tomorrow, dd/MM or dd/MM/yyyy.
errors.nonexistentDate: This day is not on the calendar.
errors.relativeWithDate: A time from now (like 30m) does not go with a date. Clear the date or enter a clock time.
errors.past: This moment has already passed. Choose a time in the future.
errors.tooFar: Messages can only be scheduled up to a year ahead.

table.title: Waiting to be sent ({count})
table.empty: Nothing is waiting. Schedule a message with the form beside this list.

cancel.planCanceled: Schedule {seq} will be canceled and its message will not be sent.
cancel.planAlready: Schedule {seq} was already canceled; nothing more to do.
cancel.planNotPending: Schedule {seq} was already sent, failed or is being sent, so it cannot be canceled.
